title: Smithing Overhaul
description: Overhauls smithing table to replace the crafting table.
body:
![A smithing table on a mountain](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e34b379c4a40793537d71ca09be3e22ae38a488.png)
This is a data pack that adds recipes for smithing table to replace the functionality of crafting tables.

# HOW TO USE
The output of the usual crafting table recipe had been replaced with smithing table.

To make an item, place ingredients at the three slots at the left.
For example, cobblestone at left (template), stick at middle (base) and cobblestone at right (material), have a cobblestone pickaxe.

# HOW TO INSTALL
Just a data pack. See [here.](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Tutorial:Installing_a_data_pack)
